data.rationale: The proposal has the same four steps in the same order (DEALS, Deals & Promotions, open the All Regions dropdown, pick a region) and the same region parameter. The last step lists example options instead of saying to use {region}, which is a minor vagueness, but a browser automation could still be built from it.
